scope: Readiness-driven protected exchanges: the production worker waits on libcoap network readiness and timers together with its owner pipes

source_identity.kind: exact source-file SHA-256; no source commit association asserted

defect.observed: The worker polled only its owner stdin and stdout with a 50 ms interval and serviced libcoap without waiting on its socket, so every protected round trip waited for that interval
defect.negative_control: The new 32-request assertion failed against the preceding worker after 3532 ms on macOS arm64
defect.consequence: A protected 20,000-byte Block1 upload took 4047 ms, so a 1 MiB whole body could not complete inside the 60000 ms maximum interaction deadline

assertions: On epoll builds the worker polls the libcoap descriptor with its owner pipes and bounds the wait by the next libcoap timer
Without epoll the worker passes its owner descriptors to coap_io_process_with_fds, which waits on libcoap sockets and timers
A following zero-timeout poll reports exact owner descriptor events, preserving pipe-error, EOF and closing behavior
Thirty-two sequential protected GET exchanges through public custody complete in less than 1000 ms with exact correlated responses
Every earlier unary, streamed-body, Observe, renewal, observation-fault, freshness, wraparound, renewal-cancel, owner-EOF and saturated-output trace in the same harness still passes

lanes.assertion_output: WCO-N02/N04: production worker completes unary, streamed and Observe exchanges

lanes.command: docker build -f Dockerfile -t wotex-coap-agent-native:wait CONTEXT (native/oscore sources, patches, yyjson, test/native sources and the pinned archive as source.tar.gz)
lanes.assertion_output: WCO-N02/N04: production worker completes unary, streamed and Observe exchanges

unaccepted: Actual BEAM Port-mailbox saturation and mailbox-size sampling
Reserved control-slot delivery while both the Port mailbox and operating-system pipe are saturated
Abrupt owner loss while Observe registration, renewal or explicit cancellation is still pending
Successful cancellation confirmation while renewal is in flight
Authenticated duplicate/stale notification injection through the complete protected worker
Live OSCORE replay/duplicate and restart fault matrix through the complete worker
